column3: NKJV lacks “according to God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text includes it (“willingly, as God would have it”).
NKJV has “called us” and the wish “may … perfect, establish,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “called you” and the future “will … restore.”
NKJV includes “the glory and,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
